# Regional Totals Summary Report

## Overview
This report summarizes the financial records processed from `/workspace/data/records.csv`.

## Data Summary
- **Total Records Processed**: 18 records
- **Time Period**: Records R002-R024 (with gaps at R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021)

## Regional Breakdown

| Region | Total Amount (cents) | USD Equivalent |
|--------|-------------------|-----------------|
| South  | 257,703           | $2,577.03      |
| West   | 324,174           | $3,241.74      |
| North  | 380,102           | $3,801.02      |
| **TOTAL** | **962,979**     | **$9,629.79**  |

## Key Findings
- The **North** region had the highest total amount at $3,801.02
- The **West** region contributed $3,241.74
- The **South** region contributed $2,577.03
- Combined total across all regions: $9,629.79

## Notes
Six record IDs (R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021) were not found in the input CSV file. All available 18 records were successfully processed and included in the totals above.
